name: Progress M-SO1
about: Progress M-SO1 (2001-041A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M-SO), launched 2001 Sep 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2001 Sep 16), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
